title: Redis command timeouts
description: Order requests are slow and Redis GET commands repeatedly time out.
expectedRootCause: Packet latency between the order service and Redis exceeds the command timeout.

title: Inventory database pool exhausted
description: Inventory requests block while all database connections remain checked out.
expectedRootCause: A leaked transaction keeps connections checked out until the pool reaches its limit.

title: Payment API error spike
description: Payment requests return HTTP 500 and the error rate is above threshold.
expectedRootCause: A malformed routing configuration introduced an empty default payment channel.

title: Notification queue backlog
description: Consumer lag grows quickly while message processing throughput falls.
expectedRootCause: A stalled template renderer blocks the single consumer worker.

title: Ingestion disk is full
description: The log ingestion service cannot persist checkpoints because storage is full.
expectedRootCause: Fixture log retention was configured without an upper storage bound.
